summary.name: AutoMute
summary.one_liner: AutoMute is a Mac utility that automatically mutes the sound when the Mac wakes up or when headphones disconnect, whether wired or over Bluetooth.
use_cases: Stop music from blasting when opening a laptop at the office
Mute speakers when Bluetooth headset moves out of range
Silence Mac audio when headphones are unplugged
Avoid unexpected sound after waking a sleeping Mac
summary.what_it_does: While AutoMute is running, it mutes the Mac's sound whenever the Mac wakes from sleep. It also mutes the sound when headphones get disconnected, whether they were physically unplugged or lost over Bluetooth. This stops the Mac from switching output to its built-in speakers when a Bluetooth headset drops out of range. The page describes it as a background tool that acts automatically once running. Contact is offered through the author for questions or feedback.
notable: Mutes automatically on Mac wake from sleep
Detects both wired and Bluetooth headphone disconnects
Runs in the background once started
caveats: Pricing and license are not stated on the page
Page only describes behavior; no installation or version details given
